photos.title: Pawleys Island at the North Causeway from above
photos.what: Pawleys Island at the North Causeway from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): The North Causeway crosses the salt marsh and its tidal creeks from the mainland at upper left to the island; on the island, one or two rows of houses stand between the marsh side and the beach; long private docks run into the marsh; the Atlantic Ocean at right. Labels placed from coordinates (images.json).
photos.caption: Pawleys Island at the North Causeway from above: the salt marsh, the causeway, and the rows of houses between the marsh and the beach.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of Pawleys Island, labelled: the North Causeway crossing the salt marsh from the mainland to the island, a narrow strip of houses, and the Atlantic Ocean

place.sublocation: The North Causeway and the middle of the island

photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. photos.title: Marsh walkway Pawleys
photos.what: A wooden walkway with a small roofed platform runs out over the salt marsh to a tidal creek, with marsh grass, trees and a road behind.
photos.caption: A walkway and a covered platform over the creek on the marsh side of Pawleys Island.
photos.alt: A wooden walkway with a small roofed platform over a tidal creek and marsh grass on Pawleys Island

photos.title: Pawleys Island North End
photos.what: A wide, flat beach at low tide in the foreground; a row of raised two- and three-story houses along the dune line at left; the inlet and the far shore with more houses at right; big cumulus clouds. A few people far off and too small to recognize.
photos.caption: The north end of Pawleys Island at low tide: houses along the dune line, and the inlet at right.
photos.alt: A wide beach at low tide with a row of raised houses along the dunes and an inlet beyond
photos.author: Phoebe
photos.credit: Photo: Phoebe, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
